name: Pakaur

queries.query: Pakaur Jharkhand official cadastral map land records parcel map Jharbhoomi
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official District Pakur land-records service page. It identifies Jharkhand's Jharbhoomi portal as the land-records destination, but the district page itself exposes no parcel API, layer schema, CRS, or geometry. Direct anonymous requests to the current Jharbhoomi and Bhu-Naksha hosts timed out before a usable response.

queries.query: पाकुड़ झारखंड आधिकारिक भू नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख खसरा नक्शा
queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery reached the official Hindi District Pakur land-records page (HTTP 200). Its legacy link directs to the Jharkhand land-records portal, but no public parcel service endpoint, schema, CRS, or safe parcel geometry was exposed in the page. The current official portal host timed out on bounded anonymous GET attempts.

registryEvidence.custodian: The District Pakur, Government of Jharkhand page is local government evidence for the district land-records service, and it points to Jharbhoomi. The Department of Revenue, Registration & Land Reforms / NIC Jharbhoomi portal is recorded as the state-level custodian. No usable Pakur-local public parcel map/API was independently evidenced.
registryEvidence.scope: The official district pages provide service direction and contact context, not an anonymous parcel geometry service. General Jharbhoomi availability is not treated as proof of a city-specific endpoint.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: registryFound remains null because no local public registry/cadastre/map endpoint with inspectable parcel data was reached in this attempt. This is not evidence of citywide absence.

parcelDiscovery.source: Official District Pakur land-records pages and the linked Jharkhand Jharbhoomi/Bhu-Naksha hosts

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 HTML received. The page identifies online land records and links users to https://jharbhoomi.jharkhand.gov.in/. No parcel layer, API, schema, CRS, or geometry was present in the page.
HTTP 200 HTML received. Hindi page repeats the Jharbhoomi destination through a legacy link; no parcel geometry or safe native identity was exposed.

Anonymous TLS GET attempted with a 10-second connect and 20-second total timeout; connection timed out. No login, credential, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, token, or TLS verification disablement was attempted.
Anonymous bounded GET attempted; no usable response was obtained before timeout. No JavaScript/configuration, public API route, schema, CRS, or parcel response could be inspected.
Anonymous bounded GET attempted; TLS connection timed out. No map extent, exact-point hit, or absence conclusion was made.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point [24.6412093934569, 87.8544542652207] was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test. No parcel layer was reachable, so no point query was issued. No raw source attributes or geometry were retained.

uncertainty: The official Jharbhoomi/Bhu-Naksha service may be interactive, intermittently unavailable, protected, or expose routes not discoverable from the district page; this attempt did not use login or private access.
A timeout is transport evidence only and is not evidence that Pakaur lacks cadastral coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime adapter admission.
